changes.title: What to expect from new Apple CEO John Ternus as Tim Cook steps down
changes.summary: John Ternus officially took over for Tim Cook as Apple CEO on Tuesday, becoming the tech giant's first new leader in 15 years. CBS News' Jo Ling Kent reports and CBS News contributor Patrick McGee breaks down what to expect.
